Event Type: Network Emergency

We are performing system changes in the Stockholm location during the following emergency maintenance window. 

Start Time: 2026-09-16 03:00:00 UTC
End Time: 2026-09-16 05:00:00 UTC

We schedule higher impact maintenance events during off-peak times to maintain our ideal hosting environment. Our engineers make every effort to minimize system impact; however, Stockholm instances may be unreachable for some, or all, of the emergency maintenance window as we perform network, firmware, or host upgrades.
